coverageAssessment: Citywide extraction extent, with source-specific incompleteness. Complete source responses do not prove complete real-world amenities coverage. OSM mapping density varies; library data was last updated in February 2025.
attributionRequirements: Show the City source/terms link for City extracts.
Show © OpenStreetMap contributors with a copyright/license link wherever the OSM locations or derived access estimate are used.
Distribute the OSM-derived GeoJSON with its ODbL notice and a direct license URL; keep it separately downloadable from City datasets.
Do not relabel the combined collection as an exclusively City-authored or universally complete source.
duplicatePolicy: Each source element is retained once by its stable ID. Dedicated-library records replace the broader City service library entries. OSM node/area or City/OSM duplicates can remain; the nearest-only category heuristic never increases score for duplicate counts.
